text: I've been up with my niece all night and I'm running on empty so sorry if this doesn't make much sense. She's 5. About twenty minutes ago she had what I can only describe as a fit, she went rigid and her arms and legs were jerking and her eyes rolled up. It's never happened to her before, not once. Her mum's on nights so it's just me. The only other thing going on is her eczema's been really bad this week, dry and itchy, she's been scratching her elbows raw. I don't know what I'm meant to be doing now
